title: Person
description: One human. Stored at people/<id>.json. Only parentage is recorded here; every other kin term is derived by the kinship engine.

id.description: Permanent lowercase kebab slug. Equals the filename. Never changes, even when the person's name does.

display.description: How this person is normally written. The only required name form.

nicknames.description: Familiar or shortened personal names. Searchable.

aka.description: Other aliases, public names or identities that are neither nicknames nor former names. Searchable.

former.description: Names this person no longer uses. Searchable so older material stays findable.

pronouns.description: Ordered list of pronoun sets, most preferred first. Free text, not controlled vocabulary, displayed exactly as written. The only gender the record carries, and it is never used to pick a kinship term.

status.description: merged marks a duplicate tombstone and requires mergedInto. It is never used for an active person.

mergedInto.description: The surviving person this tombstone redirects to. Required when status is merged, forbidden otherwise.

parents.description: Zero or more parentage edges. Order is not meaningful. Siblings, cousins and in-laws are derived, never stored.

confidence.description: The only provenance field kept. Anything below certain renders as a dashed edge.

links.description: Free key to location map for outside material, such as an Obsidian note path.

notes.description: Inline markdown. Beyond roughly 20 lines move it to notes/<id>.md; the loader merges both and the sidecar wins.

author.description: Who wrote the record. Agents must set this honestly.

date.description: EDTF subset, parsed by src/model/date.ts. The parser is the authority on what is well formed; null means unknown.
